title: Exploring the hepatoprotective effects of perillyl alcohol in the experimental models of acute liver injury.
authors: Lu, Shengyuan; Zhu, Xinran; Zhang, Feng; Zhang, Zhenzhen; Gao, Mingkai; Li, Wenwen; Yin, Zequn; Duan, Yajun; Zhang, Shuang; Zhao, Zhiwei
one_liner_zh: 研究紫苏醇对急性肝损伤的保护作用，涉及NF-κB/NLRP3蛋白的分子对接，但核心是炎症与肝损伤，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: AIMS: Acute liver injury (ALI), a severe and potentially fatal inflammation-mediated process of hepatocellular damage, remains a critical clinical concern. The goal of this study was to investigate the protective effects of Perillyl alcohol (POH), a naturally occurring monoterpene with potent anti-inflammatory properties, on LPS/D-GalN-induced ALI in both in vivo and in vitro models. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this study, POH was used as a pretreatment to assess its effects on ALI. In vivo and in vitro models of ALI were induced using lipopolysaccharide (LPS) plus D-Galactosamine (D-GalN). The therapeutic impact of POH was evaluated through measures of inflammation, oxidative stress, hepatocyte apoptosis, and macrophage infiltration. Additionally, transcriptome and molecular docking analyses were performed to explore the molecular mechanisms underlying POH is protective effects. KEY FINDINGS: The experimental results revealed that POH pretreatment significantly alleviated ALI. POH dose-dependently reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine levels, macrophage infiltration, hepatocyte apoptosis, and oxidative stress. Molecular analyses identified that POH inhibited the release of inflammatory factors by directly targeting NF-kappaB and NLRP3 proteins. The protective effects of POH were comparable to the effects of NF-kappaB and NLRP3 inhibitors (PDTC and MCC950, respectively). SIGNIFICANCE: This study demonstrates the potential of POH as a protective agent against LPS/D-GalN-induced ALI by modulating the NF-kappaB and NLRP3 signaling pathways. These findings provide valuable insights into the potential of natural anti-inflammatory compounds in liver injury management.
abstract_zh: 目的：急性肝损伤（ALI）是一种严重且可能致命的炎症介导的肝细胞损伤过程，仍是临床关注的重点。本研究旨在探讨天然单萜类化合物紫苏醇（POH）——具有强效抗炎特性——在体内和体外模型中对LPS/D-GalN诱导的ALI的保护作用。材料与方法：本研究采用POH预处理以评估其对ALI的影响。通过脂多糖（LPS）加D-半乳糖胺（D-GalN）诱导体内和体外ALI模型。通过炎症、氧化应激、肝细胞凋亡和巨噬细胞浸润等指标评估POH的治疗效果。此外，进行了转录组学和分子对接分析，以探讨POH保护作用的分子机制。主要发现：实验结果显示，POH预处理显著缓解了ALI。POH剂量依赖性地降低了促炎细胞因子水平、巨噬细胞浸润、肝细胞凋亡和氧化应激。分子分析表明，POH通过直接靶向NF-kappaB和NLRP3蛋白抑制炎症因子的释放。POH的保护作用与NF-kappaB和NLRP3抑制剂（分别为PDTC和MCC950）的效果相当。意义：本研究证明POH通过调节NF-kappaB和NLRP3信号通路，具有对抗LPS/D-GalN诱导的ALI的保护潜力。这些发现为天然抗炎化合物在肝损伤管理中的应用提供了有价值的见解。
